A systemd unit: whether it runs, and whether it starts at boot.

```hcl
step "example" {
  service {
    name = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | No | Start at boot. Left as is when unset. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Unit name. ".service" is added when there is no suffix. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | What happens on the host when this resource is removed: "forget" (default) leaves the unit, "delete" stops and disables it. |
| `state` | string | No | "started" or "stopped". Left as is when unset. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_service.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `is_enabled` | bool | Whether the unit starts at boot. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |
| `running` | bool | Whether the unit is running. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_service` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
